protocol_notes: Policy library fitted once with default h=2.5σ on train.
Threshold variants change test-time ARD h only; features, kappa, mu0 updates and resets unchanged.
h calibrated on no-change simulations (VAR(1) fitted to the train reference window); achieved rate reported on separate held-out simulations.
Historical (train/test) alarms are reported as alarms, not labelled false.
Causal eval disables max(baseline, adapted) look-ahead selection; in paper mode train is streamed through the detector before test.
warning: Pilot-scale compute/profile may be below paper budgets. Do not claim paper Table 2 replication.

null_model.fit_window: first 252 train days (detector initial reference window)
